Two looks for Claimball: Classic and Notebook

Notebook is a paper-and-grid-notebook style that matches the Claimball website, and you can switch any time in Settings.

In short: Claimball has two looks, Classic and Notebook. Notebook is a paper-and-grid-notebook style that matches the Claimball website, and you can switch in Settings at any time without restarting. Classic stays the default. It is still in testing and coming soon to iOS and Android.

Build 9, a TestFlight internal test build, gave the game a second look. It is not released to the public yet.

Notebook

Notebook is a paper-and-grid-notebook style that matches this website, which suits a game played on a notebook grid.

How to switch

Pick Classic or Notebook in Settings, at the bottom of the settings card. You can switch at any time, even in the middle of a session, and nothing restarts. Classic stays the default, so the game looks the same until you change it.

Per device

Your theme choice is saved on each device and is not shared through iCloud, so a phone and a tablet can use different looks.

What is next

Claimball is still in testing and coming soon to iOS and Android. There is no release date yet.

FAQ

How do I switch between Classic and Notebook?

Pick Classic or Notebook in Settings, at the bottom of the settings card. You can switch at any time, even in the middle of a session, and nothing restarts.

Which look is the default?

Classic stays the default, so the game looks the same until you change it.

Is my theme choice shared between devices?

No. Your theme choice is saved on each device and is not shared through iCloud, so a phone and a tablet can use different looks.

Is Claimball released yet?

Not yet. It is still in testing and coming soon to iOS and Android, and there is no release date yet.

About the game: Claimball is a casual duel game on a notebook grid for iOS and Android (coming soon, not yet released).
